segs.t: Guys, two years ago we had an hair styling tool brand which did over 8 million euros in
revenue just selling in Europe only but we ended up losing our brand overnight.
And the reason for that was because we ended up getting screwed by our supplier.
Literally ghosted us and we had to shut down the store.
It was one of the biggest lessons that I learned in e-com in order to not have one
supplier manage your whole supply chain.
But the second biggest thing that made us change our complete business was literally
focusing on MR.
Our first brand did not have any subscription model to it and we were so dependent on
Facebook having a good ROAS meaning a good day, having a bad ROAS meaning a bad day or
even no profit.
What we then eventually ended up doing was switching to an MR model, switching to supplements
which we now run a brand that is now doing $3 million every single month.
The biggest needle mover for this was literally just switching the business model.
One time purchase brands are not the way to go in 2026 because a lot of people can
just end up starting a Shopify store like this, especially with AI coming out.
So what you need to go ahead and do is make sure to build a consumables brand
with MRR so that you have monthly recurring revenue coming in and that is how you're going
to be able to compound that per month and also outskill your competitors.
If you want to find out exactly how we've built our supplement brand to doing $3 million

text: Guys, two years ago we had an hair styling tool brand which did over 8 million euros in revenue just selling in Europe only but we ended up losing our brand overnight. And the reason for that was because we ended up getting screwed by our supplier. Literally ghosted us and we had to shut down the store. It was one of the biggest lessons that I learned in e-com in order to not have one supplier manage your whole supply chain. But the second biggest thing that made us change our complete business was literally focusing on MR. Our first brand did not have any subscription model to it and we were so dependent on Facebook having a good ROAS meaning a good day, having a bad ROAS meaning a bad day or even no profit. What we then eventually ended up doing was switching to an MR model, switching to supplements which we now run a brand that is now doing $3 million every single month. The biggest needle mover for this was literally just switching the business model. One time purchase brands are not the way to go in 2026 because a lot of people can just end up starting a Shopify store like this, especially with AI coming out. So what you need to go ahead and do is make sure to build a consumables brand with MRR so that you have monthly recurring revenue coming in and that is how you're going to be able to compound that per month and also outskill your competitors. If you want to find out exactly how we've built our supplement brand to doing $3 million a month, comment, playbook below and I'll send it over to you.
